title: Vision Plans Member Terms for Out-of-Network Services
content:
**Evidence of Coverage, Vision Plans — Services from Providers Outside the Network**

**Terms in force.** Copays are not deducted from out-of-network reimbursements. Lens options are not reimbursed where the plan does not reimburse lens options out of network. Frequency limits and contacts-in-lieu apply exactly as in network. A reimbursed out-of-network service carries the remark for a paid out-of-network reimbursement.

**Term no longer in force.** The following term is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for out-of-network claims in the vision claim rules:

*No longer in force:* "A service from a provider without a Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement in force on the date of service is paid to the member as a reimbursement of the lesser of the member's paid receipt (the retail charge) and the plan's out-of-network amount for the service: the out-of-network exam amount, the out-of-network frame amount, the lens amount for the lens type (progressive lenses of either kind use the progressive amount), the elective contact-lens amount or the medically necessary contact-lens amount." Under this withdrawn term the exam, frame and elective contact-lens reimbursements were each the lesser of the receipt and the corresponding out-of-network amount.

**Questions on the terms in force**

- *Is the member's exam or materials copay taken off an out-of-network reimbursement?* No. Copays are not deducted from out-of-network reimbursements.
- *Is an anti-reflective coating bought out of network reimbursed?* Not where the plan does not reimburse lens options out of network.
- *Do frequency limits stop applying when the member goes out of network?* No. Frequency limits and contacts-in-lieu apply exactly as in network.

superseded_clauses: A service from a provider without a Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement in force on the date of service is paid to the member as a reimbursement of the lesser of the member's paid receipt (retail_charge) and the plan's out-of-network amount for the service: oon_exam_reimbursement, oon_frame_reimbursement, the lens amount for the lens_type (progressive lenses of either kind use oon_progressive_reimbursement), oon_contacts_elective_reimbursement or oon_contacts_medically_necessary_reimbursement.
